environment.description: Same ECS Fargate service behind ALB, but the RDS PostgreSQL instance uses a custom parameter group with pgAudit AND the database connection uses a restricted user configured with a security_barrier view layer. The app_user does NOT have direct SELECT on the 'reports' table; instead it has SELECT only on 'reports_v' which is a security_barrier view defined as: CREATE VIEW reports_v WITH (security_barrier=true) AS SELECT id, title, category, created_at, author_id, content, internal_notes, financial_data, tenant_id, visibility FROM reports. Additionally, the RDS instance has the 'pg_stat_statements' extension tracking all queries, and a Lambda function triggered by CloudWatch Logs Insights metric filter on pgAudit logs fires an SNS alert + revokes session on detection of ORDER BY clauses containing subqueries or CASE expressions (pattern: 'ORDER BY.*(SELECT|CASE|IF|UNION)'). The pg_user has statement_timeout set to 200ms preventing time-based blind extraction.

config.db_grants: REVOKE ALL ON TABLE reports FROM app_user; CREATE VIEW reports_v WITH (security_barrier=true) AS SELECT id, title, category, created_at, author_id, content, internal_notes, financial_data, tenant_id, visibility FROM reports; GRANT SELECT ON reports_v TO app_user; GRANT INSERT, UPDATE ON reports_v TO app_user;

lambda_monitor.trigger: CloudWatch Logs metric filter on pgAudit output
